'''2008 Worlds Day 1 Peter Davis LS Local Uprising''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Peter Davis]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 1). Sheet name Peter 'No Nickname' Davis. Sheet start line We'll Handle This (Naboo Local Uprising package).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Peter Davis]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Local Uprising / Liberation|Local Uprising]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
